verdict.rationale: First-party docs name an official Python library and a JavaScript library ([ollama-docs-19]), with dedicated pages for using Ollama from Python ([ollama-docs-10]) and from JavaScript/TypeScript ([ollama-docs-11]). These sit on top of a REST API ([ollama-gh-4]), and OpenAI-client compatibility ([ollama-docs-12]) extends what clients can call it. Missing for 10: library depth and feature coverage (e.g. streaming, async, API surface), confirmation that the libraries are first-party repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the client libraries.
